greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Amen. Siyavuya ukuba nawe namhlanje kulo mthandazo, apho sizisa iintliziyo zethu phambi koThixo.
penitential: Nkosi, sibonise inceba yakho. Kristu, sibonise inceba yakho. Nkosi, sibonise inceba yakho.
psalm_response: OyiNgcwele, oyiNgcwele, oyiNgcwele Nkosi, Thixo onamandla!
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubona umntu emi phambi komnyango ovalekileyo, elinde ukuba uvuleke. Mhlawumbi uthe chu, ujonge ngaphakathi, uzibuza ukuba yintoni na eyenzekayo phaya ngaphakathi. KwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo yanamhlanje, uYohane akaboni nje umnyango; ubona 'umnyango ovulekileyo ezulwini.' Uva ilizwi elinjengesandi sexilongo lisithi, 'Nyuka apha, ndikubonise okuya kwenzeka emva koko.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UYohane akazange azikhethele ukunyuka. Ukhutshwe ngumoya. Ufakwe kwimeko apho angabona khona ubungangamsha bukaThixo, apho kukho itrone, apho kukho imibala efana ne-jasper ne-carnelian, apho kukho ukukhanya okungathethekiyo.

Benjamin Vo wayeyiqonda le ntsingiselo yokubona ngaphaya kwale nto ibonakalayo. Khumbula indlela awayethanda ngayo iinqwelo-moya, ngakumbi i-Boeing 737. Wayengajongi nje inqwelo-moya njengesinyithi esibhabha emoyeni; wayebona ubuchwepheshe, wayebona ukulungelelaniswa, wayebona iphupha elikhulu. Xa wayethetha nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe, wayegigitheka, emomotheka, kwaye amehlo akhe ayekhanya ngendlela eyayibonisa ukuba ubona into esengqondweni yakhe—into engazange yabe ikho, kodwa eyayiyinyaniso kuye. Ben wayengumfana owayenenqgondo ebanzi, eyayikwazi ukubona ubuhle kwizinto ezincinci, ezinjengokulungisa i-cloud infrastructure okanye ukucodinga imidlalo kwi-github yakhe.

Kodwa masithethe inyaniso namhlanje. Alan noThao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane mihlanu idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, kukho amaxesha apho lo 'mnyango' ubonakala uvaliwe kwaye ubumnyama buza ngamandla. Kukho amaxesha apho ukungabikho kukaBen kwenza ikhaya libe ngenye indlela. Mamele kakuhle: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho iintlungu ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu usixelela umzekeliso ngomphathi owanika izicaka zakhe iimali ukuze zisebenze. Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Kukho isicaka esoyikayo, esifihle imali yaso emhlabeni ngenxa yokoyika umphathi waso. Ngamanye amaxesha, iintlungu zenza ukuba sifune ukufihla iintliziyo zethu, ukuzivalela, ukoyika ukuba ukuba siyakuvula, siza kubuhlungu ngakumbi. Kodwa Ben wayengafani neso sicaka. Wayengumfana owayenentliziyo evulekileyo, intliziyo eyayikwazi ukunika—njengaxa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Le yimfihlelo yobomi: asikokuba unika malini, kodwa ukuba intliziyo yakho ikulungele na ukunika. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayengoyiki ukuzama, owayengoyiki ukunika, owayengoyiki ukubona ubomi njengohambo olukhulu.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha.

KwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo, siva izidalwa ezine zexela: 'OyiNgcwele, oyiNgcwele, oyiNgcwele Nkosi, Thixo onamandla.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Le yingoma yezulu. Le yingoma uBen ayivayo ngoku. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kwiSakramente eNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ukukwamkela ngoku kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya. Ndikwamkela njengokuba sele ukhona, kwaye ndizimanyanisa ngokupheleleyo nawe. Ungandivumeli ndahlukane nawe nanini na. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onamandla angakusikelela, akugcine, kwaye akukhanyisele ubuso bakhe ngawe. Hamba ngoxolo.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen kunye nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu.
Sithandazela bonke abasemlilweni, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Mna, Yohane, ndabona umnyango ovulekileyo ezulwini, ndeva ilizwi elinjengesandi sexilongo lisithi, 'Nyuka apha, ndikubonise okuya kwenzeka emva koko.' Kwangoko ndafakwa kuMoya. Kwakukho itrone ezulwini, kwaye kuyo kwakuhleli lowo ubumhlophe bakhe buqaqambile njenge-jasper ne-carnelian. Ngaku-tron kwakukho isaphetha-mvula esinjenge-emerald. Ndabona ezinye iitrone ezingamashumi amabini anesine, apho kwakuhleli abadala abangamashumi amabini anesine, beinxibe iimpahla ezimhlophe benemiqhele yegolide ezintloko. Etroneni kwaphuma imibane, ukuduma, nezandi zendudumo. Izikhuni ezisixhenxe ezivuthayo zazivutha phambi kwetrone, ezo zingoomoya abasixhenxe bakaThixo. Phambi kwetrone kwakukho into efana nolwandle lweglasi olunjengekristale. Phakathi nasecaleni kwetrone, kwakukho izidalwa ezine ezinamehlo phambi nasemva. Esokuqala sasifana nengonyama, esesibini sasifana nethole, esesithathu sasinobuso obunjengobomntu, esesine sasifana nokhozi olubhabhayo. Izidalwa ezine, nganye inamaphiko amathandathu, zazigcwele amehlo ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Imini nobusuku aziphumli zikhala: 'OyiNgcwele, oyiNgcwele, oyiNgcwele Nkosi Thixo onamandla, owayekho, okhoyo, nozayo.' Nanini na izidalwa ezine zinika uzuko nembeko kunye nombulelo kulowo uhleli etroneni, ophilayo ngonaphakade, abadala abangamashumi amabini anesine bayawa phambi kwalowo uhleli etroneni, bamkhonze ophila ngonaphakade. Baphosa imiqhele yabo phambi kwetrone, bekhala: 'Ufanelekile, Nkosi Thixo wethu, ukwamkela uzuko nembeko namandla, kuba wena wadala zonke izinto; ngenxa yentando yakho zafika zaba khona, zadalwa.'

readings.label: IHubo
readings.text: R. OyiNgcwele, oyiNgcwele, oyiNgcwele Nkosi, Thixo onamandla! Dumisani iNkosi endaweni yayo engcwele, yidumise esibhakabhakeni samandla ayo. Yidumise ngenxa yezenzo zayo ezinamandla, yidumise ngenxa yobukhulu bayo obungummangaliso. R. OyiNgcwele, oyiNgcwele, oyiNgcwele Nkosi, Thixo onamandla! Yidumise ngesandi sexilongo, yidumise ngeharepa nomrhubhe. Yidumise ngetimbile nangomdaniso, yidumise ngemitya nangemibhobho. R. OyiNgcwele, oyiNgcwele, oyiNgcwele Nkosi, Thixo onamandla! Yidumise ngamacangci avakalayo, yidumise ngamacangci akhala kakhulu. Konke okunomphefumlo makuyidumise iNkosi! Alleluia. R. OyiNgcwele, oyiNgcwele, oyiNgcwele Nkosi, Thixo onamandla!

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Ngeli lixa abantu bebaphulaphule uYesu, waqhubeka ebalisa umzekeliso kuba wayekufuphi neJerusalem kwaye babecinga ukuba uBukumkani bukaThixo buza kubonakala apho kwangoko. Wathi, 'Indoda ebalulekileyo yahamba yaya kwilizwe elikude ukuze ifumane ubukumkani kwayo ize ibuye. Yabiza izicaka zayo ezilishumi, yazinika iingqekembe ezilishumi zegolide, yathi, "Sebenzisani ezi ekuthengiseni de ndibuye." Kodwa izakhamuzi zakowayo zaziyidelela, zathumela abathunywa emva kwayo ukuba bathi, "Asifuni le ndoda ibe ngukumkani wethu." Kodwa xa yabuya emva kokufumana ubukumkani, yabiza izicaka ezo yayizinike imali, ukuze yazi ukuba zizuze ntoni ngokuthengisa. Esokuqala seza phambili sathi, "Nkosi, ingqekembe yakho yegolide izuze ezinye ezilishumi." Yaphendula yathi, "Wenze kakuhle, sicaka esilungileyo! Uthembekile kule nto incinci; phatha izixeko ezilishumi." Esesibini seza sathi, "Ingqekembe yakho yegolide, nkosi, izuze ezinye ezintlanu." Keso sicaka yathi, "Wena, phatha izixeko ezintlanu." Esesithathu seza sathi, "Nkosi, nantsi ingqekembe yakho yegolide; ndiyigcine kwilaphu, kuba bendikoyika, kuba ungumntu ofuna okuninzi; uthatha into ongayibekanga, uvune into ongayityalanga." Yathi kuso, "Ngawo amazwi akho ndiza kukugweba, sicaka esikhohlakeleyo. Ubuwazi ukuba ndingumntu ofuna okuninzi, ndithatha into endingayibekanga, ndivuna into endingayityalanga; kutheni ungayibekanga imali yam ebhankini? Ngoko xa ndibuyayo bendiya kuyiqokelela nenzala." Yathi kwababejongi, "Thathani ingqekembe yegolide kuso, niyinike isicaka esineshumi." Kodwa bathi kuyo, "Nkosi, sineshumi iingqekembe zegolide." Yaphendula yathi, "Ndithi kuni, wonke umntu onayo, uya kongezwa, kodwa kulowo ungenayo, nento anayo iya kususwa. Ngoku ke, abo batshaba bam ababengafuni ndibe ngukumkani wabo, baziseni apha nibabulale phambi kwam." Emva kokuba etshilo, waqhubeka nohambo lwakhe esiya eJerusalem.'

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
